object.claim_boundary: This object compresses already-built Manzanita public-safe and internal candidate capabilities into one ordinary working model and local pilot-preparation surface. It is not Manzanita Works institutional adoption, a volunteer assignment, a field program, a participant record, a work order, an eligibility system, a fundraising system, a payment system, a public release authorization, or proof that any pilot exists.

purpose: Make a future return by organizational leadership an input event rather than a prerequisite for understanding or preserving the system. A returning decision-maker should be able to select one bounded problem, identify the organization-owned seats and unresolved gates, export a no-effect preparation packet, and reach the deeper technical surfaces only when needed.

source_surfaces.role: One public-safe demonstration place across seven apertures, eight conditions, five operating seats, source state, safe action, acceptance, and handoff.
Bounded case records, decisions, source receipts, effect firewall, contained roles, replay, and portable handoff.
Program organs, capacity classes, vendor boundaries, institutional substrate, and organization-owned record law.
Provider fallback, map-only honesty, source-scene selection, and image-edge registration proposal without physical-feature authority.
Resident, nursery/grower, crew/steward, planner/program, and cold-successor projections with distinct authority, acceptance, export, failure, and prohibited consequences.
One place composed across seven apertures, eight overlays, five roles, source failures, help, export, and FAB handoff.

pilot_gates.label: Choose one problem
pilot_gates.acceptance: One real case class is named; generic transformation language is insufficient.

pilot_gates.label: Name the accountable sponsor
pilot_gates.acceptance: The actor who owns the organizational promise, budget envelope, boundary, and stop authority is explicit.

pilot_gates.label: Assign and fund the continuity operator
pilot_gates.acceptance: The bounded human operating function is explicitly assigned and resourced; it does not default to a founder, advisor, volunteer, or builder.

pilot_gates.label: Name venue, resources, and field partners
pilot_gates.acceptance: The actually available venue, participant class, resources, lawful access, skills, equipment, money, and escalation path are bounded for the pilot.

pilot_gates.label: Set the effect boundary and stop conditions
pilot_gates.acceptance: Permitted effects, prohibited effects, separate-consent gates, review requirements, and conditions that halt the pilot are explicit.

invariants: Silence is not consent, assignment, rejection, expiration, or completion unless a separately stated expiration rule applies.
An unanswered offer stays unresolved; capability and proximity do not assign the nearest person.
Authority never transfers because evidence is visible or a preparation packet is complete.
Assistance and place evidence may not become insurance, underwriting, eligibility, enforcement, property, resident, or other adverse standing.
Affected actors retain correction, refusal, narrowing, deferral, acceptance, and appeal where applicable.
Replaceable vendors may perform jobs but may not become the canonical institutional model by convenience.
Continuity is a function carried by records, receipts, replay, and a bounded operating seat rather than heroic memory.

pilot_export.claim_boundary: A generated packet is local preparation. It does not contact, schedule, assign, spend, enroll, inspect, publish, represent, authorize work, accept institutional scope, or release a field pilot.

progressive_disclosure.first_view: One problem, one owner, one bounded promise; representative case selection; silence invariant.
progressive_disclosure.second_view: Seven-stage operating grammar and the prepared-versus-prohibited consequence for the selected case.
progressive_disclosure.third_view: Existing independently governed surfaces and the five organization-owned pilot gates.
progressive_disclosure.advanced_view: Place Fabric, Essential Attention, Operating Fabric, Street Glide, five-role, and whole-experience evidence.

release_holds: No Manzanita Works institutional acceptance receipt is present for this candidate.
No pilot sponsor, funded continuity operator, venue, resource envelope, participant class, or field partner is admitted by this candidate.
No participant consent, private household record, lawful field-access receipt, work authorization, completion receipt, or field acceptance is admitted.
No public promotion is authorized merely by passing repository or browser qualification.
control_question: Can an organizational decision-maker who has not followed the architecture select one real problem, understand the source-authority-action boundary in minutes, see what already exists, name the five organization-owned gates, and export a bounded no-effect pilot packet without being asked to review the entire system or silently assigning labor?
